result.summary: The page is mostly clean, but there is one noticeable visual defect in the 'Popular right now' section where delivery metadata text appears to overlap or collide, hurting readability.

issues.description: In the 'Popular right now' card for Tokumaru Ramen Bar, the delivery time text ('25-30 min') and the word 'delivery' appear to overlap or render with insufficient spacing, making the metadata line look broken and harder to read.
issues.suggestion: Increase spacing or separate the delivery time badge from the 'delivery' label so the two text elements do not collide, and ensure consistent text rendering across restaurant cards.
